content: How Acme invoices are generated each month.
raw_content:
# Billing guide

Invoices are generated on the first day of each month.

Refunds are processed within 5 business days.

Taxes are calculated from your billing address.

title: Refunds | Acme Docs

# Refunds

Refunds go back to the original payment method.
